key_insight: DP-Learner predicts electronic-structure Hamiltonians directly as symmetry-preserving operator blocks, avoiding explicit decomposition into irreducible spherical tensors.
engineering_relevance: Keeping orbital and spin couplings in contiguous blocks could improve hardware efficiency and accelerate Hamiltonian prediction for materials modeling.
method: Performs Transformer message passing on Hamiltonian-like matrices or tensors in direct-product space.
Uses Lie-generator directional embeddings and invariantly weighted products and contractions to preserve rotation, spin, and inversion symmetries.
Routes information through invariant scalar gating, attention, and environment-dependent interactions.
evidence_signal: The authors introduce MP-HAM-110K with over 110,000 structures across 68 elements and report improved accuracy and inference efficiency on it and Materials-HAM-SOC, without numerical gains in the abstract.
watch_item: Performance and memory scaling for large orbital bases should be verified; the abstract provides no quantitative benchmarks or hardware details.
paper_title: Equivariant Deep Learning in Direct-Product Space for Electronic-Structure Hamiltonian Prediction
